conclusion: Morocco remains research-only. The evidence base now includes historical direct producer cost interviews for Souss-Massa greenhouse tomatoes (MAD 500,000-600,000/ha per campaign in the 2024 period, excluding depreciation, packing and freight), an INRA-affiliated academic survey describing market-price budgets from approximately 20 farms but with numeric budget tables unavailable on the landing page, October 2026 sector-reported cost/yield stress, and the 2026 soft-wheat campaign reference price of MAD 280/quintal with important delivery and intermediary conditions. None is a complete, current, nationally representative crop budget. No calculator data are activated.
